Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: B.E/B.Tech in Computer Science Engineering (CSE) or Information Technology (IT) with a minimum of 3 years of relevant experience in project implementation roles.

content_sections.heading: IIT Bhubaneswar ERP Implementation Architect Recruitment 2026 - Important Dates
How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who meet the eligibility criteria can apply online for the IIT Bhubaneswar ERP Implementation Architect Recruitment 2026. Applications must be submitted online on or before 23-08-2026. To apply directly, use the Apply Online link provided in the Important Links section. Alternatively, candidates may visit the official website of IIT Bhubaneswar to complete the application. Fill out the application form carefully with correct personal, educational, and contact details. Upload required documents such as photograph, signature, and certificates in the prescribed format. Pay the application fee online, if applicable. Review all details carefully before submitting the form. Take a printout or save a copy of the submitted application for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for the ERP Implementation Architect post at IIT Bhubaneswar?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the online application for the ERP Implementation Architect position at IIT Bhubaneswar is 23rd August 2026.

faq.question: Q2. What is the educational qualification required for this recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a B.E/B.Tech degree in CSE/IT and have at least 3 years of relevant experience in project implementation roles.

faq.question: Q3. What is the age limit for the ERP Implementation Architect role?
faq.answer: The maximum age limit for the ERP Implementation Architect position is 45 years.

faq.question: Q4. Is there any application fee for this recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee mentioned for any category (General/OBC, SC/ST) for this recruitment.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary offered for the ERP Implementation Architect position?
faq.answer: The selected candidates will receive a salary ranging from Rs. 80,000 to Rs. 1,00,000 per month.

faq.question: Q6. How many vacancies are available for the ERP Implementation Architect post?
faq.answer: There are a total of 3 vacancies for the ERP Implementation Architect post at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q7. What is the mode of application for this job?
faq.answer: The application process for this recruitment is entirely online.

faq.question: Q8. What are the selection stages for the ERP Implementation Architect role?
faq.answer: The selection process includes a Skill Test, Presentation, and an Interview.

faq.question: Q9. What is the job type for this contract position?
faq.answer: This is a contract-based job opportunity at IIT Bhubaneswar.

faq.question: Q10. Where can I find the official notification and apply online?
faq.answer: You can find the official notification and the apply online link in the 'Important Links' section of this article.
